form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: NO report type is marked. All five 'Mark the applicable report' radio buttons on the cover are empty circles, so report_type_printed is "" - the filer checked nothing. Worth noting for the index: this cover's option list does not even offer a Convention report (its five options are 30 Days after withdrawal or elimination / Seven days preceding the Primary Election / 30 Days after the Primary Election / Seven days preceding the General Election / 30 Days after the General Election), while index.csv carries reporting_period 'Convention'; the page face does not support that label. The amendment question IS answered - 'No' is filled. Address block and signature are blacked out (redacted upstream by the county), so residence_city is "". Figures are typed and crisp. The cover header names Clerk/Auditor 'Josh Daniels', the summary page (p6) header names 'Amelia Powers Gardner' - two form vintages bound into one PDF.

notes: Page 7 is the county's internal 'CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST' (two staff review blocks, both dated 4/4/2022), not a second report - it carries no filer-stated totals. The OCR locator flagged it as a summary page; it is not. This PDF contains ONE report.

itemized.notes: 2022 cycle, `modern_boxAF`. ⚠ **NEW SOURCE PROPERTY — THIS IS A THIRD 2022 COVER VINTAGE, OLDER THAN BOTH BLANKS §J1 DESCRIBES.** Its five report types are '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination / Seven days preceding the Primary Election / **30 Days after the Primary Election (If eliminated at the Primary Election)** / Seven days preceding the General Election / 30 Days after the General Election'. It therefore has NO 'Seven days preceding Convention' option and DOES have the '30 Days after the Primary' option — which is precisely the pair of changes §J5 records the `v. 4.20` blank as having made (gaining Convention, losing 30-days-after-Primary). So the stock in circulation in 2022 is at least THREE deep: this pre-4.20 cover, the `v. 4.20` carry-over, and the newer unversioned six-type blank — and the wave's tell-table should be read as a sequence, not a pair. Consistent with the older vintage, its close box is UNLETTERED ('Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)', no G), its Schedule A third column is 'Address and Zip Code' with no In-Kind checkbox, and it foliates with 'Date of Report' + 'Page'. All 8 pages rot 0 (pdfinfo -f 1 -l 8); no rotation handling needed. AcroForm present; every entered value is machine type. PAGE STRUCTURE, classified from each page's own printed header and never by ordinal: p1 COVER; p2, p3 and p4 are THREE 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received' sheets, each with its own page subtotal and each repeating the same grand total; p5 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made'; p6 'Summary Page'; p7 the CHECKLIST DECOY; p8 BLANK. THE SUMMARY PAGE IS AT p6, NOT LAST — two further sheets follow it — so an ordinal rule would have missed it. **THE CHECKLIST DECOY IS BOUND AT p7**, immediately after the genuine Summary Page at p6, the §J2 pattern again; it is the OTHER revision of the decoy — its top-right box offers 'Website / Network / **HOLD**' (three options, where the Herring filing's copy in this same chunk offers only Website/Network), its two review copies are labelled '**Staff Signature #1**' and '**Staff Signature #2**' rather than a bare 'Staff Signature', and its last summary line reads '**Positive** balance at Close of Reporting Period'. Both copies are signed and dated 4/4/22 and 4/4/2022, in red and in magenta, and the sheet is born-digital clean. It carries ZERO dollar figures, it is a clerk work product, it is NOT part of the filing, and no figure was taken from it. PAGE-FACE IDENTITY: candidate 'David Leavitt' on the cover, p2, p5 and p6, and 'David O Leavitt' on p3 and p4 — recorded as varying within the one document and not adjudicated; Office box prints 'Utah County Attorney'; Date, Date of Report and every inner-sheet date read 04/01/2022 (p3 and p4 write it '4/01/2022' and '4/1/2022'); foliation runs 1-6 counting the cover, and the checklist and the blank verso are unfoliated. ⚠ **NO REPORT TYPE IS MARKED** — all five 'Mark the applicable report' radios are empty circles. That is an honest BLANK and is never read as any particular report; index.csv's channel label calls the period 'Convention', which the page does not state, and the two are recorded side by side with neither adjudicated. The amendment question IS answered: 'No' is filled. REDACTION judged PER CELL from the page, exactly as §I3 warns: the cover's Address/City/State/Zip block and the Signature block are solid black bars, while Phone and Email are in the clear; and on the schedules the county barred the STREET portion of some donor address cells while leaving the city, state and ZIP printed beside the bar — and other rows carry no bar at all because the filer had entered only a ZIP. Both patterns occur on the same page. No street address is carried into this record from any row, and the vendor cell on Schedule B lines 1-2 that embeds a street address is reduced to its name portion. Both sides close exactly on their promoted per-period cells against four (contributions) and three (expenditures) agreeing printed statements; the cover ladder also closes to the cent; nothing was nudged and no figure was taken from any other document.
